headline: Ecuador Antitrust Regulator Clears Alicorp's Purchase of Florafood
summary: Ecuador's competition authority approved Peruvian consumer goods conglomerate Alicorp's acquisition of Florafood Ecuador, a margarine importer, without conditions.
why: Alicorp is Peru's largest consumer goods company; expanding its footprint in Ecuador broadens its regional packaged food distribution.

impacts.name: Alicorp S.A.A.
impacts.why: Unconditional antitrust approval enables Alicorp to take control of Ecuadorian margarine distribution.
